Our Story

ABOUT GAULDENTRAP

Premium cannabis sourced, tested and shipped with the professionalism this category deserves.

Who We Are

PREMIUM CANNABIS.
NO COMPROMISE.

Gauldentrap was built on a simple belief: people deserve access to genuinely premium cannabis — properly grown, accurately described, rigorously tested, and shipped with the discretion and professionalism that this category deserves.

We source from cultivators and manufacturers who can back every claim with documentation. Every product in our catalogue has been third-party lab tested for potency, purity, pesticides and heavy metals before it is listed. We do not carry products we cannot verify.

Our catalogue covers everything from AAAA+ craft flower and live resin concentrates to premium edibles, vapes, hash, pre-rolls, CBD and more — all shipped discreetly to the USA, Canada, UK, EU, Australia and New Zealand.

How We Work

OUR STANDARDS

🏢 Sourcing

We work exclusively with established cultivators and licensed manufacturers. Every supplier goes through a vetting process before their products appear on our platform. We do not list products from unverified sources regardless of how popular they may be.

🧪 Lab Testing

Every product is third-party lab tested before it is listed. We check for cannabinoid potency (THC, CBD, CBG), terpene profiles, pesticide residue, heavy metals and microbials. Certificates of Analysis are available on request for any product in our catalogue.

📦 Packaging

Every order is triple vacuum-sealed to eliminate odour completely, then placed inside a plain outer box or padded envelope. No cannabis-related branding, no product names, no indication of contents on the outside. The return label uses a neutral business name. It looks like any ordinary parcel.

🔒 Privacy

We do not share customer information with any third parties. Your order details, contact information and purchase history are kept strictly private. We communicate by email and we keep those communications professional and discreet. We never reach out unsolicited after your order is complete.

💬

QUESTIONS OR WANT TO TALK?

We are here for product advice, order support, bulk enquiries or just general questions. We respond within 2 hours.

faq.html:
Home›FAQ
Help Centre

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Everything you need to know about ordering, shipping, payment and products. Can't find your answer? Contact us and we'll get back to you within 2 hours.

ORDERING

Our minimum order is $200 USD or the equivalent in your selected currency. This applies to all orders across all product categories. Orders below this amount cannot proceed to checkout. The minimum exists because our fulfilment, packaging and shipping process has a fixed cost and we want to ensure every order is handled to the same high standard.

Browse any category, select your preferred products and weight options, add them to your cart and proceed to checkout. At checkout you enter your shipping details, choose a payment method and submit your order. You will receive a confirmation email immediately. We then contact you within 2 hours with payment instructions and dispatch confirmation.

You can request changes or cancellation by emailing support@gauldentrap.com within 1 hour of placing your order. Once an order has been packaged and dispatched it cannot be modified or cancelled. If your order has already shipped, our 30-day guarantee still applies if anything is wrong when it arrives.

No account is required. You provide your shipping and contact details at checkout and we handle everything from there. Your cart is stored locally in your browser so it persists between visits without needing a login.

Yes. Simply enter the recipient's shipping address at checkout and note in the special notes field that it is a gift. Our packaging is completely plain and discreet so the contents are not revealed. We do not include any pricing information inside the package.

PAYMENT

We accept Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, USDT, LTC), bank transfer (wire, SWIFT, ACH, IBAN), and credit or debit card for orders of $1,000 and above. We also accept local payment methods on a case-by-case basis — describe your preferred method in the Other field at checkout and we will confirm availability.

Cryptocurrency payments eliminate processing fees and chargebacks on our end, and settlement is instant. We pass those savings directly to you as an additional 5% discount. This stacks on top of whatever volume discount tier your order qualifies for. A $500 order with crypto gets 10% volume off plus 5% crypto off — 15% total.

We do not charge you at checkout. Instead, you submit your order with all your details and we send payment instructions to your email within 2 hours. You then send payment and we dispatch once confirmed. This process is standard for our type of operation and protects both parties.

We never ask for card numbers or banking credentials by email. For card payments we send a secure payment link from our processor. For crypto we send a wallet address. For bank transfer we send account details via email. Never send cash or gift cards — we do not accept these.

No. The price you see is the price you pay. Shipping is free on all orders. The only adjustments are the volume discount (which reduces your total) and the optional crypto bonus discount. There are no processing fees, customs fees charged by us, or handling charges added at checkout.

SHIPPING & DELIVERY

Every order is triple vacuum-sealed to eliminate odour, then placed inside a plain outer box or padded envelope. There is no cannabis-related branding, product names or any indication of contents on the outside. The sender name on the label is a neutral business name. Your order looks identical to any ordinary parcel.

Most orders arrive within 3 to 7 business days. USA and Canadian orders are typically at the faster end of that range. International orders to the UK, EU, Australia and New Zealand are usually 5 to 7 business days. You receive a tracking number by email once your order ships.

We ship to the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, and all European Union member states. If your country is not listed, contact us — we may be able to accommodate specific requests on a case-by-case basis.

No. We do not require any identification at the door. Age verification is completed once at checkout when you confirm you are of legal age in your jurisdiction. Our packaging gives no indication of what is inside so there is nothing that would prompt a delivery driver to ask for ID.

Delays beyond 7 business days are uncommon but can occur due to customs processing or carrier backlogs. If your order has not arrived within 10 business days of your dispatch notification, contact us at support@gauldentrap.com with your order number and we will investigate and resolve it.

PRODUCTS & QUALITY

Yes. Every product we carry is third-party lab tested for cannabinoid potency, purity, pesticide residue and heavy metals before it is listed on our store. Certificates of Analysis are available on request for any product. We source exclusively from cultivators and manufacturers who can provide full lab documentation.

These are quality grades applied to cannabis flower. AAAA+ is the highest tier — small-batch craft flower that is hand-trimmed, extremely dense, heavily frosted with trichomes and cured to perfection. AAAA is premium commercial-grade with excellent bag appeal and potency. AAA is solid mid-tier flower with good effects and decent trim. AA is budget-grade that still delivers reliable effects at a more accessible price point. All grades are lab tested and accurately described.

Indica strains are typically associated with relaxing, sedating body effects best suited to evening use. Sativa strains tend to produce more uplifting, cerebral and energising effects suited to daytime use. Hybrids carry characteristics of both and usually lean towards one or the other. Modern cannabis genetics have blurred these distinctions considerably — terpene profiles often matter more than the classification alone.

THCa is tetrahydrocannabinolic acid, the raw precursor to THC found in living cannabis plants. In its natural form it is non-psychoactive. When heated through smoking or vaporising, it undergoes decarboxylation and converts to Delta-9 THC, producing the same psychoactive effects as standard cannabis flower. In terms of appearance, aroma and smoke, THCa flower is essentially identical to regular cannabis.

Cannabis flower and concentrates should be stored in airtight glass containers away from heat, light and humidity. Edibles should be kept in a cool dry place or refrigerated in warmer climates. Vape cartridges should be stored upright at room temperature away from sunlight. All products should be kept out of reach of children and clearly labelled if removed from original packaging.

RETURNS & GUARANTEE

If your order arrives damaged, incorrect or defective we will replace it within 30 days. Contact us at support@gauldentrap.com within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and clear photo or video evidence of the issue. We will arrange a replacement shipment at no cost to you. No arguments, no runaround.

Contact us within 48 hours of receiving your order with your order number and a description of what is missing. We will cross-reference your order details and arrange a resolution promptly. Photographic evidence of what you received is helpful but we understand this is not always possible.

We are unable to accept returns on cannabis products for preference or change of mind. All product descriptions are accurate and we encourage you to use the product-specific FAQs and reviews to make an informed choice before ordering. If you are unsure between products, contact us before ordering and we will advise.

Seizure by customs is extremely rare given our packaging methods. In the unlikely event your order is seized and does not arrive, contact us with documentation and we will review on a case-by-case basis. We take our packaging and compliance seriously and work hard to ensure every order arrives safely.

💬

STILL HAVE A QUESTION?

Our team responds within 2 hours during business hours.

Contact Us →

Home›Shipping
Shipping & Delivery

SHIPPING POLICY

Everything you need to know about how we pack, dispatch and deliver your order.

Overview

Every order placed at Gauldentrap is shipped with the same commitment to discretion, speed and reliability regardless of order size. We fulfil orders Monday through Saturday. Orders confirmed before 2pm EST on a business day are typically dispatched same day or the following morning.

📦 Packaging

Triple vacuum-sealed inside. Plain outer box or padded envelope. No branding, no product references, no indication of contents. Neutral business name on return label.

🚚 Dispatch Speed

Standard orders: dispatched within 1 business day of payment confirmation. Crypto orders: same-day dispatch when payment confirms (usually within 2 hours).

⏳ Delivery Time

3 to 7 business days for most destinations. Tracking number emailed once dispatched. Expedited shipping available at checkout for faster delivery.

🚚 Free Shipping

Shipping is free on all orders. There are no shipping fees, handling charges or hidden costs added at checkout. The price you see is the price you pay.

Countries We Ship To

We currently ship to the following countries and regions. If your country is not listed, contact us — we may be able to accommodate specific requests.

🇺🇸 United States 🇨🇦 Canada 🇬🇧 United Kingdom 🇦🇺 Australia 🇳🇿 New Zealand 🇩🇪 Germany 🇫🇷 France 🇮🇹 Italy 🇪🇸 Spain 🇳🇱 Netherlands 🇧🇪 Belgium 🇦🇹 Austria 🇵🇹 Portugal 🇮🇪 Ireland 🇸🇪 Sweden 🇩🇰 Denmark 🇫🇮 Finland 🇵🇱 Poland + Other EU states

Delivery Timeframes

The following are estimated delivery windows from dispatch date. These are estimates based on typical carrier performance and may vary due to customs processing, carrier backlogs or public holidays.

  • United States: 3 to 5 business days
  • Canada: 3 to 6 business days
  • United Kingdom: 4 to 7 business days
  • Australia & New Zealand: 5 to 8 business days
  • European Union: 5 to 8 business days

Tracking Your Order

Once your order is dispatched you will receive a tracking number by email. You can use this tracking number directly on the carrier's website or through any major parcel tracking service. If you have not received a tracking email within 2 business days of your payment being confirmed, check your spam folder and then contact us at support@gauldentrap.com.

Customs & International Shipping

All international orders are packaged and labelled to pass through customs without any reference to cannabis, controlled substances or the nature of the contents. Our packaging and documentation process has been refined over millions of deliveries. Customs delays can occasionally extend delivery windows but outright seizure is extremely rare.

In the unlikely event that an order is seized by customs, contact us with documentation and we will review on a case-by-case basis. We take our packaging methodology seriously and work to ensure every order arrives safely.

ID at Delivery

We do not require identification at the door. Age verification is completed once at checkout when you confirm you are of legal age in your jurisdiction. Our packaging contains no indication of what is inside so there is nothing that would prompt a carrier to request identification.

Delays and Missing Orders

If your order has not arrived within 10 business days of your dispatch notification please contact us at support@gauldentrap.com with your order number. We will investigate with the carrier and resolve the situation promptly. Please do not wait beyond 14 business days to report a missing order as this limits our ability to investigate.

This shipping policy was last updated January 2026.

returns.title: Returns & Guarantee
returns.html:
Home›Returns & Guarantee
Returns & Guarantee

30-DAY GUARANTEE

If something is wrong with your order we will make it right — no arguments, no runaround.

Our 30-Day Guarantee

We stand behind every product we sell. If your order arrives damaged, defective or incorrect — or if something is missing — we will make it right. No arguments, no lengthy back-and-forth, no runaround.

✅ What We Cover

Damaged products on arrival • Incorrect items sent • Missing items from your order • Products that arrive in unsatisfactory condition • Packaging failures that compromise product integrity

How to Claim

Contact us at support@gauldentrap.com within 48 hours of receiving your order. Include the following:

  • Your order number
  • A clear description of the issue
  • Photo or video evidence of the problem (where possible)
  • The email address used to place the order

We aim to respond to all claims within 2 hours during business hours. Once your claim is verified we will arrange a replacement shipment or resolution at no cost to you. Replacements are typically dispatched within 1 to 2 business days of claim approval.

Timeframes

  • Report window: Within 48 hours of delivery for damage or incorrect items
  • Missing item window: Within 72 hours of the expected delivery date
  • Guarantee period: 30 days from dispatch date
  • Our response time: Within 2 hours during business hours
  • Resolution / replacement dispatch: 1 to 2 business days after claim approval

What We Cannot Cover

We are unable to accept returns or process claims in the following circumstances:

  • Change of mind or preference after receiving a correctly fulfilled order
  • Claims submitted more than 30 days after the dispatch date
  • Damage caused by improper storage after delivery
  • Partial use of a product before raising a claim
  • Claims without any supporting information or order reference

We understand this category requires trust on both sides. We take every legitimate claim seriously and resolve them promptly. If you are ever in doubt about a product before ordering, contact us first and we will advise honestly.

Physical Returns

Due to the nature of our products and legal considerations around the return of cannabis goods, we do not accept physical returns by post. All resolutions are handled through replacement shipments. Do not attempt to return products by post as we are unable to accept or process them.

Contact for Claims

Email: support@gauldentrap.com
Subject line: Include your order number for fastest processing.
Response time: Within 2 hours Monday through Saturday, 8am to 10pm EST.

This returns policy was last updated January 2026.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.html:
Home›Privacy Policy
Legal

PRIVACY POLICY

How we collect, use and protect your personal information.

This Privacy Policy describes how Gauldentrap ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses and protects the personal information you provide when using our website and placing orders.

Information We Collect

Information you provide directly

  • Name and contact details (email address, phone number)
  • Shipping address
  • Payment method preference (we do not store payment credentials)
  • Order details and special notes
  • Communications you send to us by email or through our contact form

Information collected automatically

  • Browser type and version
  • General geographic location (country level, used for currency detection)
  • Pages visited and time spent on site
  • Referring URL

We do not use cookies for advertising or tracking purposes. Cart contents and currency preferences are stored locally in your browser using localStorage and never transmitted to our servers unless you place an order.

How We Use Your Information

  • To process and fulfil your orders
  • To communicate with you about your order status, payment and delivery
  • To respond to your enquiries and support requests
  • To send you discount codes or promotions if you have subscribed to our newsletter (you may unsubscribe at any time)
  • To improve our website and product offerings

How We Protect Your Information

All data transmitted between your browser and our website is encrypted using SSL (HTTPS). Order submissions are processed through Web3Forms, a secure third-party form service. We do not store payment card numbers, bank account details or cryptocurrency wallet credentials on our systems.

Access to customer information is restricted to the team members who need it to fulfil your order. We do not store unnecessary data and we regularly review our data retention practices.

Information Sharing

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information to any third parties for marketing purposes. We may share information in the following limited circumstances:

  • Shipping carriers: Your name and delivery address are shared with our shipping partners to fulfil your order
  • Payment processors: Where applicable, payment details are handled by third-party processors under their own privacy policies
  • Legal requirements: We may disclose information if required to do so by law or in response to a valid legal request

Data Retention

We retain order information for a period of up to 2 years to handle any guarantee claims or disputes. After this period, personal data is deleted from our systems. You may request earlier deletion of your data by contacting us at support@gauldentrap.com.

Your Rights

You have the right to request access to the personal information we hold about you, request correction of inaccurate information, request deletion of your data, and withdraw consent to receive marketing communications at any time. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at support@gauldentrap.com.

Third-Party Services

Our website uses the following third-party services which have their own privacy policies:

  • Web3Forms — form submission processing
  • Google Fonts — font delivery
  • Tawk.to — live chat support
  • ipapi.co — country detection for currency (no personal data stored)

Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, contact us at support@gauldentrap.com.

This Privacy Policy was last updated January 2026.

legal.html:
Home›Legal Disclaimer
Legal

LEGAL DISCLAIMER

Important information about age restrictions, jurisdiction and responsible use.

⚠️ Important Notice

The information and products on this website are intended only for persons of legal age in jurisdictions where the purchase and possession of cannabis products is lawful. Cannabis laws vary significantly by country, state and territory. It is your sole responsibility to ensure compliance with all applicable laws in your jurisdiction before placing an order.

Age Restriction

You must be 21 years of age or older (or the legal age in your jurisdiction, whichever is higher) to access this website and purchase products. By entering this site you confirm that you meet this age requirement. We reserve the right to refuse service to any person who cannot confirm their eligibility.

Legal Jurisdiction

Cannabis products, including those containing THC, Delta-8 THC, THCa, CBD and psilocybin, are subject to a wide range of legal frameworks globally. Some products available on this site may be legal in certain jurisdictions and restricted or prohibited in others. We do not make representations about the legality of any product in any specific jurisdiction. Customers are solely responsible for determining the legality of their purchases under applicable local, regional and national laws before ordering.

Health and Safety

Cannabis products are for adult use only. Keep all products out of reach of children and pets at all times. Do not drive, operate heavy machinery or engage in activities requiring full cognitive function after consuming cannabis products. Effects may be delayed up to two hours when consuming edibles — do not re-dose before this window has elapsed.

Cannabis products may interact with certain prescription medications. Consult your healthcare provider before using cannabis products if you are taking any regular medication, are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have a pre-existing medical condition. These products have not been evaluated by the FDA or equivalent regulatory bodies and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or condition.

Psilocybin Products

Psilocybin mushrooms and related products are controlled substances in most jurisdictions. Their legal status varies significantly and they remain illegal in many places. Customers purchasing psilocybin products are solely responsible for confirming the legal status of such products in their jurisdiction. We do not encourage the use of any controlled substance in jurisdictions where it is prohibited.

No Medical Advice

Nothing on this website constitutes medical advice. Product descriptions, effect profiles, strain information and any other content are for informational purposes only and are not intended as medical guidance. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice.

Responsible Use

We encourage responsible and informed cannabis use. Start with low doses, particularly with edibles and concentrates. Be aware of your environment and the people around you. Cannabis affects individuals differently — what is mild for one person may be intense for another. Never share cannabis products with minors.

No Warranties

While we take every measure to ensure the accuracy of product descriptions and lab test results, we make no warranties, express or implied, regarding the fitness of any product for a particular purpose. Individual experiences with cannabis products vary based on tolerance, consumption method, body weight, metabolism and many other factors.

Contact

If you have legal questions related to cannabis use in your jurisdiction, we recommend consulting a qualified legal professional. For product questions contact us at support@gauldentrap.com.

This Legal Disclaimer was last updated January 2026.
